name: super-claude
description: A comprehensive marketplace of Claude Code plugins for TypeScript, React, and Node.js development. Install individual category plugins or mix and match based on your project needs.

plugins.name: typescript-tools
plugins.description: TypeScript development tools: type checking, refactoring, import management, and test generation

plugins.name: testing-tools
plugins.description: Testing automation: Vitest integration, Playwright E2E, coverage analysis, and monorepo testing strategies

plugins.name: git-tools
plugins.description: Git workflow automation: smart commits with gitmoji, PR descriptions, changelogs, and worktree management

plugins.name: frontend-tools
plugins.description: Frontend development accelerators: React component generation, Tailwind utilities, and design patterns

plugins.name: devops-tools
plugins.description: DevOps automation: Docker Compose helpers, environment management, and GitHub Actions generation

plugins.name: skill-tools
plugins.description: Meta-tools for creating and managing Claude Code skills, commands, agents, hooks, and plugins
